description: This file defines configurations, UI component classes, and enumerations related to a Canvas Window feature in a macOS application. It includes layout constants, a subclass of NSPanel, and an enum to distinguish presentation modes.

classes.name: CanvasPanel
classes.description: A subclass of NSPanel that can become the key window and main window.

methods.name: canBecomeKey
methods.description: Overrides the NSPanel property to allow the panel to become the key window.

methods.name: canBecomeMain
methods.description: Overrides the NSPanel property to allow the panel to become the main window.
